_comment: Wallet labels for the dashboard. owner.label names the collector's wallet; watched lists extra read-only wallets (address + label). Re-read on every refresh, no restart needed. collect: true makes the collector also collect that wallet's positions (after that wallet approves the operator on the v3/v4 position managers via /approve-v3 and /approve-v4) and deliver the swept fees back to that same wallet. This file is gitignored; wallets.example.json is the template.
